## R10 — The Sailboat

- **Canvas and timebox:** 4 Zones: Island, Wind, Anchors, Rocks · 60–90 min
- **When to run it:** Teams struggling to decouple their aspirational product goals from current technical drag, organizational dependencies, and impending environmental risks.
- **Phases:**
  - Set the stage (5m): recite the Prime Directive; name the target Island.
  - Gather data (20m): five minutes per zone: Wind, Anchors, Rocks, then the Island.
  - Generate insights (20m): cluster notes; dot-vote the heaviest Anchors and Rocks.
  - Decide (15m): sever one Anchor before adding Wind; name its owner.
  - Close (5m): affirm navigation capability and capture the ROTI.
- **The move:** An Anchor becomes a systemic initiative: parallel CI under 15 minutes instead of 90; owner, date.
- **Provenance:** Source protocol: the phases and minutes follow the written sequence in the source.

## R11 — Speed Car / Race Car

- **Canvas and timebox:** 4 Zones: Engine, Parachute, Pit Stop, Hazards · 60 min
- **When to run it:** Teams experiencing velocity bottlenecks, deployment throttling, or code review stalls.
- **Phases:**
  - Set the stage (5m): recite the Prime Directive before inspecting the Parachute.
  - Gather data (15m): notes into Engine, Parachute, Pit Stop, Hazards.
  - Generate insights (20m): focus on Pit Stop; name the maintenance that prevents burnout.
  - Decide (15m): one Pit Stop item becomes an infrastructure ticket with a date.
  - Close (5m): name the Engine gain the next sprint should protect.
- **The move:** A Pit Stop card becomes infrastructure maintenance: a ticket, an owner, and a date before the next release.
- **Provenance:** Source names the canvas and the intent and leaves the phases' wording and minutes to the facilitator.

## R12 — Hot Air Balloon

- **Canvas and timebox:** 4 Zones: Hot Air, Sandbags, Storm Clouds, Skies · 60 min
- **When to run it:** Low-morale sprints where the team needs to acknowledge positive contributions while systematically identifying operational baggage.
- **Phases:**
  - Set the stage (5m): recite the Prime Directive; lift and ballast are both data.
  - Gather data (15m): notes into Hot Air, Sandbags, Storm Clouds, Skies.
  - Generate insights (20m): compare the lift of Hot Air against the drag of Sandbags.
  - Decide (15m): unclip one Sandbag; name the task or tool it retires.
  - Close (5m): state the altitude the team expects next sprint.
- **The move:** A Sandbag becomes a formal deprecation: the task or tool is retired with a date and a replacement.
- **Provenance:** Source names the canvas and the intent and leaves the phases' wording and minutes to the facilitator.

## R13 — Mountain Trek

- **Canvas and timebox:** 4 Zones: Summit, Basecamp, Crevasses, Gear · 90 min
- **When to run it:** Multi-sprint delivery campaigns, quarterly releases, or major infrastructural initiatives.
- **Phases:**
  - Set the stage (10m): recite the Prime Directive; agree the Summit's completion criteria.
  - Gather data (25m): list delivered architecture, unmonitored risks, and gear in use.
  - Generate insights (25m): trace Basecamp to Summit; name the Crevasses on that path.
  - Decide (20m): one Crevasse gets a risk-mitigation spike with an owner.
  - Close (10m): name the Gear the next leg depends on.
- **The move:** A Crevasse becomes a risk-mitigation spike on the active backlog; crossing it without the named Gear is not allowed.
- **Provenance:** Source names the canvas and the intent and leaves the phases' wording and minutes to the facilitator.

## R14 — The Hero’s Journey

- **Canvas and timebox:** 5 Stages: Ordinary World, Call, Abyss, Transformation, Elixir · 90–120 min
- **When to run it:** Post-release reviews following demanding delivery crunches or major technical recoveries.
- **Phases:**
  - Set the stage (10m): recite the Prime Directive.
  - Gather data (20m): walk the five stations in order; one note per station.
  - Generate insights (30m): harvest the Elixir; name the permanent capability.
  - Decide (25m): turn the Elixir into a runbook or decision record, with an owner.
  - Close (15m): name who supported whom at the worst point.
- **The move:** The Elixir becomes an artifact — runbook, decision record, or test — committed with an owner.
- **Provenance:** Source names the canvas and the intent and leaves the phases' wording and minutes to the facilitator.
- **Source:** Joseph Campbell (1949), *The Hero with a Thousand Faces*.

## R15 — Space Mission / Rocket

- **Canvas and timebox:** 4 Zones: Thrusters, Gravity, Asteroids, Target Orbit · 60–90 min
- **When to run it:** High-risk exploratory initiatives, zero-to-one product development, or deep R&D milestones.
- **Phases:**
  - Set the stage (5m): recite the Prime Directive; name the Target Orbit.
  - Gather data (20m): notes into Thrusters, Gravity, Asteroids, Target Orbit.
  - Generate insights (25m): test whether Thrusters outpace organizational Gravity.
  - Decide (20m): one Gravity item becomes a waiver request with an owner.
  - Close (10m): name the first asteroid the next sprint routes around.
- **The move:** A Gravity item becomes a waiver request to leadership: the rule, its cost, and the experiment.
- **Provenance:** Source names the canvas and the intent and leaves the phases' wording and minutes to the facilitator.

## R16 — Island Castaway

- **Canvas and timebox:** 4 Zones: Shelter, Fresh Spring, Predators, SOS Flare · 60 min
- **When to run it:** Sudden loss of team capacity, extreme resource starvation, or emergency operational survival mode.
- **Phases:**
  - Set the stage (5m): recite the Prime Directive; name what must survive.
  - Gather data (15m): notes into Shelter, Fresh Spring, Predators, SOS Flare.
  - Generate insights (20m): rank non-essential work against the Shelter's needs.
  - Decide (15m): cut one non-essential commitment; name what the cut protects.
  - Close (5m): confirm the SOS Flare and who fires it.
- **The move:** An SOS Flare becomes an executive escalation ticket, sent within two hours of the session, with a named owner.
- **Provenance:** Source names the canvas and the intent and leaves the phases' wording and minutes to the facilitator.

## R17 — The Submarine

- **Canvas and timebox:** 4 Zones: Propulsion, Ballast Tanks, Hull Breaches, Periscope · 60–90 min
- **When to run it:** Accumulated technical debt, creeping memory leaks, latent architectural fragility, or mounting compliance risks.
- **Phases:**
  - Set the stage (5m): recite the Prime Directive; pressure is a system property.
  - Gather data (20m): notes into Propulsion, Ballast Tanks, Hull Breaches, Periscope.
  - Generate insights (25m): quantify the pressure each Hull Breach can take.
  - Decide (20m): one Hull Breach becomes a P0 remediation ticket with a date.
  - Close (10m): name what the Periscope shows the next sprint will demand.
- **The move:** A Hull Breach enters the next sprint as P0 technical-debt remediation, with a fix and a test that would have caught it.
- **Provenance:** Source names the canvas and the intent and leaves the phases' wording and minutes to the facilitator.

## R18 — The Living Tree

- **Canvas and timebox:** 5 Zones: Roots/Soil, Trunk, Leaves, Rotten Branches, Fruit · 90 min
- **When to run it:** Annual retrospectives, long-term engineering health reviews, or major team structural reorganizations.
- **Phases:**
  - Set the stage (10m): recite the Prime Directive; roots first, canopy second.
  - Gather data (20m): notes into Roots, Trunk, Leaves, Fruit, Rotten Branches.
  - Generate insights (25m): test whether the Roots can sustain the canopy.
  - Decide (20m): one Rotten Branch gets decommissioning, not a redesign.
  - Close (15m): name the Fruit the team would protect through the next cut.
- **The move:** A Rotten Branch becomes a decommissioning ticket: the dead route, flag, or process is removed.
- **Provenance:** Source names the canvas and the intent and leaves the phases' wording and minutes to the facilitator.
